name: Rei
source:
“No, that won’t do. What if germs get in?”

She is one of Miu’s guardians, an older sister–like woman who wears a maid’s uniform. Gentle and warm-hearted, she has a deeply nurturing personality and an abundance of emotional generosity. Her skills in cooking, laundry, cleaning, and all household chores are professional-level. Polite and considerate toward everyone, she is easy to get along with. To Miu, she is both an older sister and a motherly presence.
